يرتجف (form VIII)
# يَرْتَجِفُ (yartajifu) /jar.ta.d͡ʒi.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# يَرْتَجِفَ (yartajifa) /jar.ta.d͡ʒi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
# يَرْتَجِفْ (yartajif) /jar.ta.d͡ʒif/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَجَفَ (irtajafa)
